facts.text: Lipscomb students are required to acquire 20 chapel credits to meet the chapel requirement, earned by attending Breakout Chapels and The Gathering.

sources.title: Chapel FAQ | Lipscomb University
sources.quote: Each student should acquire 20 chapel credits in order to meet the requirement. These credits are acquired by attending Breakout Chapels and The Gathering.

facts.text: The study of the Bible is integral to a Lipscomb education, and all Lipscomb students examine the Bible's overall message and the life to which it calls believers through a general education Bible requirement.

sources.title: The Academic Program - Lipscomb University
sources.quote: The study of the Bible is integral to a Lipscomb education. Although abundant opportunities for further study are available, all Lipscomb students examine the Bible's overall message and the life to which it calls believers.
